title: Parliament Budget Session 2026 Highlights: Parliament adjourned for the day
desc: Budget Session Live Highlights: The second half of Parliament’s Budget session had a turbulent start on Monday, with Opposition MPs raising slogans as External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar briefed the Rajya Sabha over the Middle East war. The Lok Sabha was scheduled to take up an opposition-sponsored resolution seeking the removal of Speaker Om Birla. The motion, backed by several opposition parties accusing Birla of acting in a “partisan” manner, was expected to trigger a sharp face-off with the ruling BJP, which has issued a whip to ensure MPs’ presence in the House. However, the issue was not taken up during the proceedings on Monday. The proceedings for Monday have ended and both Houses are adjourned till tomorrow.
